recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16959 unless a future work group decision changes the CDA II.root search guidance or the underlying Identifier mapping rule.
issue_request: The Published FHIR-core/MnM STU3 issue was resolved Not Persuasive with Modification: keep the Identifier mapping rule unchanged, but document that CDA II.root can be searched with identifier=|[root],[root] in both the search specification and the v3 II mapping guidance.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in SVN revision 14160, imported as git commit a5c90c3db3cc87902faf8b096c1fdc5f179853fc, whose subject explicitly includes GF#16959. That commit added the CDA II.root search sentence to source/datatypes-mappings.html and source/search.html.
additional_context: The current source still contains both requested pieces of guidance. source/datatypes-mappings.html explains the two HL7 v3 II-to-Identifier mapping cases and then gives the CDA II.root search syntax. source/search.html's token search summary table for Identifier also says a CDA II.root may appear in either Identifier.system or Identifier.value and gives the same syntax. FHIR-13223 is the earlier Published issue that established the root-only versus root-plus-extension Identifier mapping background; it was treated as supporting context, not a separate issue decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source already implements the Jira disposition in the two requested locations, and changing the Identifier rule itself would contradict the Not Persuasive with Modification resolution.
